{"claims":[{"claim_text":"President Biden announced executive action that significantly curtailed asylum eligibility at the border when crossings reach a certain threshold.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Biden’s executive action strengthened the ability to impose timely consequences for crossing the border illegally.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Since President Biden took executive action, unlawful entries between ports of entry declined by more than half.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Biden is changing the asylum process to more quickly screen and identify individuals who pose a threat to national security or public safety.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Individuals identified as posing a threat to national security or public safety will be swiftly removed.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The President should have emergency authority to expel migrants who are crossing unlawfully when the system is overwhelmed.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The President should stop processing asylum claims, except for those using a safe and orderly process at Ports of Entry, when the system is overwhelmed.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Emergency authority to expel migrants should be accompanied by humanitarian exceptions for vulnerable populations including unaccompanied children and victims of trafficking.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Congress should dedicate resources to detain and remove individuals quickly.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Congress should rapidly process those who cannot be detained in a non-custodial setting under government supervision.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Individuals who pose a threat to public safety or national security must be identified and removed as quickly as possible.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
